name: finereli/whatsapp-mcp
what_it_is: Small remote MCP server for searching and reading your chats.

name: lharries/whatsapp-mcp
what_it_is: The original and best-known WhatsApp MCP server: Go bridge plus Python MCP server. No commits since July 2025.

name: verygoodplugins/whatsapp-mcp
what_it_is: Maintained continuation of the original, with message search, media tools and optional transcription.

name: felipeadeildo/whatsapp-mcp
what_it_is: Cloudflare deployment with searchable storage, multiple accounts and messaging tools.

name: FelixIsaac/whatsapp-mcp-extended
what_it_is: Extended fork: group admin, webhooks, polls, recipient allowlist, selectable tool sets.

name: BrOrlandi/whatsapp-mcp-local
what_it_is: Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, or a Linux server (Docker or not), that exposes your WhatsApp as an MCP endpoint (uses wacli).
runs_on: Your computer or your server (must stay on)

name: BrOrlandi/whatsapp-mcp-server
what_it_is: Go gateway with a web panel and authenticated remote MCP. Deprecated in favour of BrOrlandi/whatsapp-mcp-local.

name: ericporres/whatsapp-mcp-server
what_it_is: Group-focused server: read, search, export and reply.
where_history_is_kept: Your machine, last 1,500 messages per group

name: delltrak/wamcp
what_it_is: TypeScript server with two backends: WhatsApp Web or the Business Cloud API.

name: WAHA MCP
what_it_is: Self-hosted WhatsApp HTTP API with a built-in MCP app and scoped keys.

name: WA MCP
what_it_is: Go bridge and Python MCP tools for chat search, local voice transcription and a daily list of open requests.
reads_sends: Reads and sends (sending off by default)

name: Automata
what_it_is: Open-source MCP server with per-chat read/write permissions; also hosted.
reads_sends: Reads; sends only in chats you allow
where_history_is_kept: Your server, or theirs if hosted

name: wa2agent
what_it_is: Hosted MCP for personal agents; you choose which chats it can see. Disclosure: built by this list's maintainer.
where_history_is_kept: Theirs: 30 days, encrypted with a key only your agent holds

name: Blueticks MCP
what_it_is: Hosted MCP connector for your WhatsApp number.
where_history_is_kept: Theirs, until you ask for deletion

name: Periskope MCP
what_it_is: Hosted MCP over a shared team inbox, chats and tickets.
where_history_is_kept: Theirs, while you use it; deleted within 30 days after

name: Perisclaw
what_it_is: Hosted MCP with sign-in for your own WhatsApp number; published ChatGPT plugin, Claude custom connector, and Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
reads_sends: Read only by default; reads and sends if you choose at sign-in
where_history_is_kept: Theirs, period not stated; isolated and encrypted per user

name: Wassenger MCP
what_it_is: Hosted MCP for chats and messaging; linked device or Business API.
where_history_is_kept: Theirs, up to 1,000 messages per chat

name: 2Chat MCP
what_it_is: Hosted MCP for WhatsApp, SMS and calls; linked device or Business API.
where_history_is_kept: Theirs, while your account is open; deleted within 6 months of closing

name: Whapi.Cloud MCP
what_it_is: Local MCP adapter for Whapi's hosted gateway.

name: GREEN-API MCP
what_it_is: Hosted MCP with messaging, notifications and groups.
price_or_license: Free developer plan (3 chats), then paid

name: WhatSync
what_it_is: Hosted MCP, one endpoint for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor; personal or Business API.

name: Meta WhatsApp Business Tools MCP
what_it_is: Meta's own MCP for account, number and template setup, plus test sends. Endpoint `https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools`.

name: Kapso MCP
what_it_is: Hosted MCP: send, read stored conversations, manage templates and webhooks.

name: SendFromChat
what_it_is: Hosted Cloud API platform with remote MCP and a REST API; handles the 24-hour window.
where_history_is_kept: Theirs, while your account is active; deleted within 30 days of workspace deletion
price_or_license: 30-day trial, then from $19/month plus Meta fees

name: FredShred7/whatsapp-mcp-server
what_it_is: Community Cloud API wrapper for messages, media and templates. Receiving needs webhooks.
where_history_is_kept: In memory only, while it runs

name: n8n
what_it_is: WhatsApp Business Cloud node and trigger; workflows can be exposed through n8n's MCP Server Trigger.
price_or_license: Free community edition; Cloud is paid

name: Zapier
what_it_is: WhatsApp Business workflows; MCP actions for sending.

name: OpenClaw
what_it_is: Agent gateway with a native WhatsApp channel that routes messages to your agent and sends replies. Linked device.

name: WhatsApp chat export
what_it_is: Export a chat as text and give it to your assistant, or use the export skill in this repo.

name: Circles
what_it_is: Hosted remote MCP and HTTP API for your personal number; you choose the chats it sees and set each to read only or read and send.
reads_sends: Reads; sends in chats you allow
where_history_is_kept: Theirs, for the history window you choose (full, 90, 60 or 30 days); unlinking deletes it
price_or_license: Free for 2 chats (up to 3 months), then from $14.90/month

name: API-Supp
what_it_is: Hosted MCP and REST API for a number you link by QR; cloud MCP covers every number on the account; optional local client adds files and voice notes.
where_history_is_kept: Theirs, while the number is active; 30-day grace after the activation window ends, then deleted

name: WA MCP
what_it_is: Hosted remote MCP for your own number, linked by QR or pairing code; Claude, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Muse and any MCP client. Send limits: messages to people who haven't written to you may be delayed or held back; no bulk sending.
where_history_is_kept: Theirs: messages 90 days, media not stored; deleting your account deletes it all at once
price_or_license: Free 1-hour trial, then a free plan; Pro from $4/month billed annually ($9 monthly)

name: WireUp
what_it_is: Hosted remote MCP for your own WhatsApp: one connector link for Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and others; search, photos and voice notes, drafts you approve before sending.
reads_sends: Reads and sends (sends wait for your approval by default)
where_history_is_kept: Theirs, for your account alone, until you unlink or delete; you can keep only the last 30 days, 6 months or a year

name: Juncts
what_it_is: Hosted remote MCP for Juncts, a paid unified inbox for WhatsApp, LinkedIn, X, Instagram and Telegram DMs; WhatsApp connects through a Chrome extension as a linked device (unofficial); you choose Read, Drafts, Organize or Full access.
reads_sends: Reads; sends only if you allow it
where_history_is_kept: Your browser; agent requests pass through an encrypted relay and results are deleted when the request finishes
runs_on: Hosted MCP, inbox in your browser
